full_prompt_en: A square expressionistic painted portrait shows an older bearded man in round dark glasses against a blazing yellow background. His head fills the frame so closely that the top of the hair and the lower shoulders are cut off. The round lenses sit just above the center, framing eyes that look straight outward with a steady, serious expression. A thick gray-black moustache crosses the upper lip and joins a short rough beard around the chin. The nose and high forehead are built from warm yellow, ochre, and orange strokes, with deep purple and blue-green shadows around the eyes. On the left side of the face, teal and olive marks cool the ear, cheek, and hairline. A dark jacket and narrow glimpse of pale shirt occupy the lower corners, but the clothes remain secondary to the large facial planes. The background is saturated lemon yellow on the right, broken by thin scratches, dragged marks, and a few dark sketch lines. A smaller turquoise patch and dripped color sit behind the left side of the head. Brushstrokes vary from broad opaque swipes to fine linear hatching in the beard, giving the image visible layers rather than a polished surface. The glasses retain precise circular rims, which stabilize the more restless paint around them. Bright, warm frontal light appears to strike the forehead and nose; cooler shadow colors define the recessed eye sockets and underside of the jaw. There is no readable lettering. The overall composition is crowded and direct, using hot yellow against cool teal and violet to give a still face energetic painted intensity.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形表现性绘画肖像呈现一位戴深色圆眼镜、蓄胡须的年长男子，背景是炽亮黄色。他的头填满画面，上方头发和下方肩膀都被裁切。圆镜片位于中央偏上，框住直视画外、坚定而严肃的双眼。浓灰黑胡须横过上唇，并与下巴周围粗短胡茬相接。鼻子和高额头由暖黄、赭黄及橙色笔触构成，眼周有深紫及蓝绿阴影。脸的左侧，青蓝与橄榄色笔痕冷却耳朵、面颊和发际。深外套和一点浅衬衫占据下方角落，但衣服次于宽大的面部平面。右侧背景是饱和柠檬黄，被细刮痕、拖曳色痕和几条深色草图线打断。头部左后方有较小的青绿斑块及滴落色痕。笔触从宽而不透明的刷痕变化到胡须中的细线排笔，使图像呈可见层次而非抛光表面。眼镜保留准确的圆形镜框，稳定其周围较躁动的色彩。明亮暖正面光似落在额头和鼻子上；冷影色界定凹陷眼窝与下颌下方。画面没有可读文字。整体构图拥挤而直接，以热黄色对照冷青与紫色，使静止面孔带有活跃的绘画强度。
style_prompt_en: The image has an expressionistic painted finish, with saturated warm color fields interrupted by scratches, drips, and visible directional brushwork. Lemon yellow and ochre occupy broad areas, while teal, blue-violet, and dark brown cut through them as cooler structural shadows. Some edges remain precise and circular, giving order to the surrounding scraped and dragged marks. Thick opaque strokes build raised planes; finer hatching and rubbed passages add rough texture in lower-value regions. The light reads as forceful and frontal, but modeling relies on bold complementary color changes as much as brightness. Close cropping gives the layered surfaces little space to settle. The overall effect is vivid, restless, and tactile, with warm-cool conflict carrying the visual energy.
style_prompt_zh: 画面具有表现性绘画完成感，饱和暖色色域被刮痕、滴痕和可见定向笔触打断。柠檬黄与赭黄占据宽阔区域，青色、蓝紫与深褐则作为较冷的结构阴影切入其中。一些边缘仍精确而圆润，为周围刮擦、拖曳痕迹提供秩序。厚而不透明的笔触构成凸起平面，细排线与磨擦色段在低明度区域增加粗糙肌理。光感强而正面，但塑造同时依靠大胆互补色转变和明度。紧密裁切让层叠表面几乎没有平息空间。整体效果鲜明、躁动而可触，视觉能量来自冷暖冲突。
theme_en: A vivid yellow and teal painted close portrait of a bearded man in round glasses
theme_zh: 一位戴圆眼镜蓄胡须的男子黄青色鲜明绘画近景
name: Francis Ford Coppola
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
